t: This is Corpus Christi, a Roman Catholic parish church in Brixton, in the Archdiocese of Southwark. It was founded in 1886 and is a Grade II* listed building. It was previously run by the Society of Jesus, the Jesuits. The architect was John Francis Bentley, who lived from 1839 to 1902. Bentley's most famous work is Westminster Cathedral, built in a style heavily influenced by Byzantine architecture, so this Brixton church comes from the same hand as that great building.
